headline: ConnectWise disables ScreenConnect extensions amid SCKit MSP attacks; N-able 4EverAble2Shell zero-day; 4,800 GitHub accounts hijacked

bullets.text: New: ConnectWise has disabled third-party ScreenConnect extensions while it investigates the attacks. The MSPs story (8 outlets) covers worm-like SCKit malware, a plugin flaw exploited to spread malware across hundreds of PCs, and breaches at nearly 50 organizations.

Still active: the N-able "4EverAble2Shell" zero-day was exploited within hours of a public PoC; no CVE or fix is on the board. New N-central exploits also work against patched servers, giving root RCE and Windows SYSTEM access.

Hackers compromised 4,800 GitHub accounts to steal cloud credentials (5 outlets), alongside a campaign targeting 60,000 GitHub repositories. Apify is rotating API tokens and prompting 2FA resets after a breach.

Apache HTTP Server patched a critical HTTP/2 RCE, CVE-2026-119618 (4 outlets). The SignDrop Windows zero-day abuses CLFS for SYSTEM access; no CVE or fix is on the board. Critical Xen Orchestra flaws are exploited (3 outlets).

Also developing: Fireworks AI hack exposed Notion chat transcripts (7 outlets); Maersk says a cyber incident hit a legacy system (WhiteArmor, 5 outlets); Red Hat Quay flaw exposes private images; US seized $1.2B in crypto stolen from Binance.

KEV due today (11-13): Barracuda CVE-2026-116606 and CVE-2026-111560. Due 11-24: Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320, Outlook CVE-2026-124194, Chromium CVE-2026-125350. SITCON 3; the last 7 days run 1.01x the 90-day average.

actions: ScreenConnect: inventory instances and extensions, confirm third-party extensions are disabled, and hunt for SCKit spreading from support sessions to client machines.
N-able / N-central: keep consoles off the internet, watch for a 4EverAble2Shell fix, and hunt for new admin accounts and unexpected agent commands.
GitHub: review org members' recent sign-ins, PATs and Actions secrets; rotate cloud credentials stored in repos or workflows, and Apify tokens if you use it.
Patch every Apache httpd instance for CVE-2026-119618 today; where you cannot, consider disabling HTTP/2 until patched.
Patch Barracuda ESG today (KEV deadline 11-13) and restrict Xen Orchestra and Red Hat Quay to trusted networks.
Hunt for unexpected CLFS-based SYSTEM escalation on Windows and for NetSupport RAT installs from ClickFix pages.
